mapper.select: INSERT INTO shot_sequences (row_version, created_at, updated_at, visual_beat_id, order_index) VALUES (#{rowVersion}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{visualBeatId}, #{orderIndex}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE shot_sequences SET order_index = #{orderIndex}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{rowVersion}
